name: Altium Packaging
old_description: Ask us about our variety of caps, closures, and liner solutions today!
about:
Altium Packaging operates from Janesville, Wisconsin, with a corporate office in Atlanta, Georgia. The company traces its roots back over a century of innovation in plastic packaging, though a specific founding year is not disclosed. Ownership structure and founder names are not publicly stated.

The company manufactures rigid plastic containers, bottles, caps, closures, and liner solutions for a wide range of markets. Its proprietary Dura-Lite® lightweighting technology reduces resin use by 5 to 32 percent while maintaining top-load strength and drop performance. Altium runs a network of more than 65 plants across the United States and Canada, staffed by nearly 4,000 employees, and operates an in-house design studio, Studio PKG™, that develops custom packaging with PCR resin options.

Altium serves the dairy, water, beverage, food, nutrition, household chemicals, specialty chemicals, automotive, personal care, and healthcare sectors. In healthcare, its Altium Healthcare line supplies containers and closures for prescription, over-the-counter, and wellness products with child- and senior-resistant features. Customers include brand owners seeking stock or custom rigid plastic packaging.

The company emphasizes a customer-centric model built on personalized service, dependability, flexibility, and creativity. It highlights sustainability practices, long-term partnerships, and its "Always Made Right®" commitment as core differentiators.
